profiles.meeting_scenario: An internal coordination meeting at a financial-data analytics company between the Economic Insights research workstream and the Transaction Intelligence data workstream. The team is preparing a joint internal milestone for an executive review and a near-final working-paper package on Brazilian intercity supply-chain networks inferred from firm-to-firm wire transfers. The agenda is to align on the city-level network extract, the recession-period comparison used in the update, the readiness of municipality mapping, and the handoff format for centrality outputs and court-efficiency enrichments. The expected outcome is apparent agreement on what will be delivered by next Friday, who will provide which artifacts, and how the research team will use them in the paper draft and executive deck.

members.name: Ana Ribeiro
members.expertise: Applied econometrics, empirical industrial organization, coordinating research deliverables for executive and publication audiences
members.background: Former central bank economist who now manages cross-functional research projects that combine transaction data with regional economic analysis.
members.private_state: Ana needs a stable package quickly so her economists can lock the draft figures and regression tables before the executive review; she is trying to minimize back-and-forth by assuming prior choices from the working-paper draft are already understood by the data team.
hidden_assumptions: "Production-ready" for this milestone means a frozen, analysis-ready extract that researchers can use without further schema changes, even if it is not yet automated.
The "recession period" is the paper's before-versus-after framing anchored on calendar year 2014, because that is how the latest draft and figures are organized.
Municipality mapping is "validated" once enough transaction value is assigned cleanly for aggregate city-network results to be stable, even if some firm-level exceptions remain.
If a cross-workstream deck already mentions court-efficiency results, the data package will usually include the enriched centrality outputs needed to reproduce those tables.
A normal handoff from data operations to research is a downloadable flat file in the shared project folder.

members.name: Bruno Carvalho
members.expertise: Payments data pipelines, entity resolution, governed data products, and operational QA for large-scale financial transaction datasets
members.background: Former fintech data engineer who now oversees regulated transaction-data pipelines and internal access layers for analytics teams.
members.private_state: Bruno wants to avoid creating ad hoc extracts that later become unofficial sources of truth; he is trying to keep the handoff within governed infrastructure and assumes the research team will do the final enrichment and interpretation steps themselves.
hidden_assumptions: "Production-ready" means the city-network dataset has been promoted to the governed workspace with scheduled refreshes, lineage, and monitoring.
The "recession period" should match the standard macro-event tagging used in internal marts rather than the narrative cutoff in a research draft.
Municipality mapping is not truly "validated" until operational QA is complete for major municipalities and the exception log is closed.
Network metrics are the data team's responsibility, but merges to external judicial-efficiency covariates remain research-owned unless explicitly reassigned.
A proper shared artifact is a governed table or view in Databricks, not a static exported file.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree that the city-network dataset should be 'production-ready by next Friday.'
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Ana means a frozen, analysis-ready extract with stable columns that her team can immediately use for figures and regressions.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Bruno means a governed data product promoted into the production workspace with scheduled jobs, QA checks, and lineage metadata.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The phrase is common in cross-functional business settings and both meanings imply maturity and reliability, so the apparent agreement feels natural and does not invite clarification in a coordination meeting.

misalignment_points.topic: Which 'recession period' they are coordinating around
misalignment_points.surface_form: They refer to using 'the recession cut from the last draft' for the updated comparison.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Ana is thinking of the paper's comparison based on a pre-2014 versus post-2014 framing, aligned to calendar-year figures in the draft.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Bruno is thinking of the internally tagged recession window in the payments mart, roughly Q2 2014 through Q4 2016.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both assume there is one obvious recession slice already established by prior work, and the phrase 'last draft' sounds specific enough to mask that they are anchoring to different artifacts.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They agree that centrality results can move forward once the municipality mapping is 'validated.'
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Ana believes validation means the assigned share of transaction value is high enough that city-level rankings and regressions are stable for research purposes.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Bruno believes validation means the operational QA checklist is complete, including resolution of major-city exceptions and sign-off on the exception log.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both treat validation as a quality gate rather than a decision point, and because neither wants to sound careless about data quality, they use the same word without surfacing their different thresholds.

misalignment_points.surface_form: They discuss Bruno sending the 'centrality pack' so Ana can finish the customer/supplier court-efficiency section.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Ana assumes the pack includes city-level centrality measures already merged to municipality identifiers and the court-efficiency lookup needed for both customer-side and supplier-side regressions.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Bruno assumes the pack only includes the network metrics and mapping keys, while the court-efficiency merge and regression-ready assembly remain with the research team.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: The term 'centrality pack' sounds like an established shared artifact, and because court-efficiency is already part of the broader project context, each side quietly folds different adjacent materials into the same label.
